name: Battle of Warsaw (1920)
note: This plan shows the whole operation of about two weeks, not a single field: each block is an army, corps or division, and distances are schematic. The Wieprz is drawn much nearer Warsaw than it lay, and the accounts do not say where the Polish 1st Legions Division stood when it began its march, so it first appears near Białystok.

phases.title: The Red Army's final assault on Warsaw
phases.text: The Soviet 16th Army attacked at Radzymin, east of Warsaw, while the 3rd and 15th Armies came up to Modlin. The Polish 5th Army had to face three Soviet armies at once.
phases.quote: The final Russian assault on Warsaw began on August 12.

phases.title: Budyonny's army marches on Lwów, not Warsaw
phases.text: The Soviet High Command ordered the 1st Cavalry Army to advance on Warsaw from the south. It marched on Lwów instead and missed the battle, leaving only a weak Mazyr Group on the southern flank.
phases.quote: Ultimately, Budyonny's forces marched on Lwów instead of Warsaw, and thus missed the battle.

phases.title: The Polish 5th Army counterattacks in the north
phases.text: The 5th Army crossed the Wkra and fought the Soviet 3rd and 15th Armies at Nasielsk. The Soviet advance towards Warsaw and Modlin was halted at the end of 15 August.
phases.quote: The Polish 5th Army counterattacked on 14 August, crossing the Wkra River.

phases.title: The Assault Group breaks through the Mazyr Group
phases.text: Piłsudski's Assault Group marched north from the Wieprz and met almost no opposition. It routed the Mazyr Group and cut the supply lines of the Soviet 16th Army.
phases.quote: On 16 August, the Polish Assault Group commanded by Piłsudski began its march north from the Wieprz River.

phases.title: The Soviet 16th Army is cut off near Białystok
phases.text: Tukhachevsky ordered a retreat, but his orders came too late or not at all. The Polish 1st Legions Division made a forced march and cut off the 16th Army, and most of its troops surrendered.
phases.quote: The division's rapid advance allowed it to intercept the 16th Soviet Army, cutting it off from reinforcements near Białystok and forcing most of its troops to surrender.

phases.title: The northern Soviet armies join the general rout
phases.text: The 15th Army, which had tried to cover the retreat of the 4th Army, was defeated twice and joined the rout. By 21 August all organised Soviet resistance had ceased.
phases.quote: However, it was defeated twice on 19 and 20 August and joined the general rout of the Red Army's North-Western Front.
